text:
cheng: Quick async check — onboarding llama3-smallq with the Spanish promptset. What I did: ran nightly_eval vs baseline and reproducer on dedicated. Results: English pass rates look unchanged, Spanish shows ~-4% BLEU and a handful of hallucinations. Blocker: suspect kv-cache alignment after the tinyq quant profile; need to try a kv warmup on a dedicated node and re-evaluate. Today: I'll open a tiny PR for a shorter kv-warmup (doesn't touch model weights) and add the failing prompt ids to the smoke set.

sara: On it — will run the warmup on a dedicated node now. Which PR?

cheng: PR #4236, small change (warmup steps + add prompt ids). I also attached one failing example in the PR: input '¿Cuál es la capital de España?' -> model outputs 'Sevilla' instead of 'Madrid'.

miguel: I can run an eval pass and capture logs. Pinging @devops-bot to spin up a ded node for this (small run, seed 42).

devops-bot: deploy: starting node-dedicated-24 for user miguel — ETA ~2m. (image: ded-gpu-rtx6000)

miguel: Finished a quick run with warmup disabled vs enabled. Summary: es BLEU drop ~3.8% without warmup; with warmup it's down ~0.7%. Also noticed decoding config mismatch — top-k changed in an earlier PR. Log snippet:
```
Prompt id: es-smoke-112
Input: "¿Cuál es la capital de España?"
Baseline output: "Madrid"
Current output: "Sevilla"
Decoder: top_k=50 -> current top_k=10
```

sara: Ah — that top_k change came from #4219 (decoding defaults). Do we want to revert #4219 or try kv warmup first?

cheng: Try warmup first since #4236 is non-invasive and already covers the failing ids. I'll hold off on reverting #4219 until we see warmup results. If warmup doesn't fix >80% of failing cases, we'll roll back decoding defaults. Thanks for the quick run everyone :thumbsup:

miguel: Queued a full smoke run with warmup and will post detailed metrics when complete.
